[[File:Mythical cape detail.png|left|140px]]
The '''mythical cape''' is a cape that can only be worn by those who have completed the [[Dragon Slayer II]] [[quest]].

It can be purchased from [[Jack]] at the [[Mythical Cape Store]] on the top floor of the [[Myths' Guild]] for {{NoCoins|10000|c}}. The cape provides unlimited free teleports to the guild. The mythical cape has the highest crush attack bonus of any [[cape slot]] item in ''Old School RuneScape'', providing a +6 bonus.

{{Costume storage|cape rack}} It may also be [[Mythical cape (mounted)|mounted]] in the [[Quest Hall]] in the [[Guild trophy space]], or the [[cape hanger]] in the [[Achievement Gallery]], of a [[player-owned house]]. While mounted, the player can use it to teleport to the Myths' Guild.

==Trivia==
[[File:Buffs, Deadman and Mythical Cape Designs (5).png|thumb|250px|The candidates in the mythical cape design poll along with their artists]]
* The design of the cape was the result of a [[Update:Dragon Slayer II Dev Update, Design Competition & Changes|design contest]], followed by the [[Poll:Mythical Cape|Mythical Cape poll]], in which a design submitted by ''JackScape'' won.
* The cape could be seen being worn by [[Alec Kincade]] and [[Ponts the Bridgemaster]] following an [[Update:The Corsair Curse and Wilderness Chaos Altar|update]] around a month prior to release.
